name: Ahmet the Davulcu
personality: Warm and patient with travelers, fiercely protective of his village.
secret: His drum contains a coded map to a forgotten royal vault.
rumor: Villagers say his drumbeat can frighten spirits away.
party_hook: He asks the party to escort him to a ruined watchtower before the next full moon.
appearance: A broad-shouldered man with a braided beard, a red sash, and a weathered davul.
background: A former soldier who became a traveling festival drummer after the border wars.
goals: Protect his village and discover who hid the map inside his drum.
relationships: He supports the village healer and distrusts the tax collector.
voice_style: Deep and rhythmic, with a storyteller's careful pauses.
catchphrases: Every heart knows the beat. Keep yours steady.

world_integration.reputation: A reliable veteran and a welcome guest at village festivals.
world_integration.factions: Independent; formerly served in the border militia.
world_integration.current_location: The village square, rehearsing for the harvest festival.
world_integration.reaction_matrix: Welcomes respectful strangers, questions armed trespassers, and defends threatened villagers.
world_integration.on_defeat: Surrenders to protect bystanders and offers information in exchange for their safety.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Years of marching and carrying his heavy drum.

actions.name: Thunderous Drumstrike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. The enchanted drum releases a focused burst of thunder.

traits.name: Steady Rhythm
traits.description: He uses measured drumbeats to coordinate his allies and keep frightened villagers calm.
